subject: CHANGES REQUESTED S20 @017555f: real IFrame player never readies in the opaque sandbox (blocker); 2 .apkg DoS (high); speed label invisible, fullscreen denied (medium)
body:
Review of S20 at 017555f (claude/naadi-shared). Reviewer: review20. Lead decision 20261117T052800-lead-170cb2 checked.

## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED (1 blocker, 2 high, 2 medium, 2 low, 1 nit)

### What holds
- Parent CSP is `script-src 'self'` and `frame-src 'self'` (checked live on an APP_ENV=prod server). /sandbox/youtube.html has its own CSP (script-src youtube.com, frame-src youtube-nocookie.com, `sandbox allow-scripts`). The iframe has no allow-same-origin.
- Bridge (bridge.ts / bridgePlayer.ts / sandbox/youtube.ts): every message is checked by source window, origin ("null" one way, parentOrigin the other) and shape (id regex, numeric bounds). Nothing secret goes over `*`.
- Facade: no frame, script or thumbnail before the click. youtube-nocookie is the only player host; there is no youtube.com/embed anywhere in web/src.
- YOUTUBE_API_KEY: SecretStr in settings.py, used server-side only. HttpError is re-raised as `http_<status>` from None, so the key URL never leaks. Per-run Quota ledger (stop early); add_by_url is capped at Quota(20) per call and admin-gated.
- .apkg: member count and size caps, path traversal refused, capped zstd, SQLite read-only (query_only, trusted_schema off, authorizer). HTML is rebuilt into strict TipTap nodes, so script/style/iframe/handlers are dropped. Images are re-encoded to WebP through Pillow with an allowlist and a pixel cap; audio is dropped. Imported media rows use source_id 'user-upload'. Export returns only the owner's cards.
- Migration 0023: RLS and grants are in the same migration (video_candidates is forced RLS, revoked from anon/authenticated). Private media read policy is owner-only. test_migrate asserts a single head.
- ui_copy: anki and video are in the noHardcodedCopy roots and vitest is green. One lime CTA per view in the screenshots.

### Defects
1. **BLOCKER: the real IFrame Player never becomes ready inside the sandbox, so the video is unusable.** apps/web/src/video/bridge.ts:15 (SANDBOX_ATTR) + apps/api/naadi_api/security.py:111 (CSP `sandbox allow-scripts`).
   - Cause: sandbox flags are inherited by nested frames. The youtube-nocookie embed therefore also gets an opaque origin, and the widget↔embed postMessage handshake fails. Chromium logs "Failed to execute 'postMessage' on 'DOMWindow': The target origin provided ('https://www.youtube-nocookie.com') does not match the recipient window's origin ('null')" repeatedly, plus jserror beacons from the embed.
   - Result: `ready` is never sent. The player area stays black, the "press once to play" step never happens, and speed, chapters and "Note at" stay hidden or disabled (they are gated on `ready`).
   - Repro (real network; youtube.com is reachable from the sandbox):
     1. Serve dist with `APP_ENV=prod uvicorn naadi_api.main:app` (NAADI_STATIC_DIR=apps/web/dist).
     2. In Playwright Chromium (through the proxy) open any same-origin page and add `<iframe src=/sandbox/youtube.html sandbox=allow-scripts allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; fullscreen">`.
     3. Answer `hello` with `{ns:'naadi:yt',type:'init',videoId:'M7lc1UVf-VE',start:30,parentOrigin:location.origin}`.
     4. Wait 15 s. Messages received: only `hello`. No ready, time, error or api_failed.
   - Control: the same YT.Player code on a plain unsandboxed localhost page reaches onReady within seconds, with rates 0.25–2.
   - Why CI is green: e2e/video.spec.ts:43-54 replaces iframe_api with a fake YT.Player that calls onReady itself, so the real handshake is never exercised.
   - Not checked: WebKit could not be probed here (upgrade-insecure-requests on the http probe server). It inherits the sandbox the same way, so expect the same result.
   - **This conflicts with the lead decision as written, so the lead needs to re-decide.** Possible option: serve the player page from a separate origin/host with `sandbox allow-scripts allow-same-origin` (isolated from the app's storage because the origin is different). Another option: keep the opaque wrapper but get the embed out of the sandbox, which browsers don't allow, so likely not viable. Either way, add an opt-in real-network check, or move it to the device checklist as a gate rather than a note.
2. **HIGH: crafted .apkg hangs a worker forever (SQLite).** apps/api/naadi_api/anki/apkg.py:294-301 and :183.
   - `cards` (or `notes`) can be a VIEW with a never-ending recursive CTE. The authorizer explicitly allows SQLITE_RECURSIVE, and there is no progress handler or deadline.
   - parse() runs in asyncio.to_thread, which cannot be cancelled. 6 imports per 10 min per user can tie up the default executor and every other to_thread user on the Space.
   - Repro: an anki2 collection with `create view cards as with recursive r(x) as (select 1 union all select x+1 from r) select 0 ord,0 odid,1 did,1 nid,x id from r where x<0;` plus one note, zipped as collection.anki2. `Package(p).parse()` is still running after 20 s and never returns.
   - Fix direction: conn.set_progress_handler with a step or deadline budget, deny SQLITE_RECURSIVE, require cards/notes/col to be real tables (sqlite_master type='table'), and add a test.
3. **HIGH: the cloze regex is super-linear.** apps/api/naadi_api/anki/apkg.py:364 (`_CLOZE`, lazy `.*?` twice with DOTALL), applied per cloze card.
   - Repro: `render("{{cloze:Text}}", Ctx({"Text": "{{c1::"*n}, "D","Cloze",[],1), "q", "")`. n=500 takes 1.8 s, n=1000 takes 15 s, n=2000 (a 12 KB field) takes 117 s. That is per card, and fields can be MBs.
   - Fix direction: a linear scanner (or `[^}]*` plus explicit nesting handling), a field length cap before render, and a timing test.
4. **MEDIUM: the selected speed option's label is invisible.** apps/web/src/video/YouTubeVideo.tsx:170 with `btn` (line ~118).
   - The button carries both `text-text` (from btn) and `text-ground`. In the built CSS `.text-text` comes later (offset 47575 vs 47221), so it wins: light text on a paper background.
   - The screenshots (.tmp/shots/video/player--webkit-phone-390.png and ipad-landscape) show a blank white pill. The selected state is then fill-only, against the "never colour-only" rule.
   - Fix: drop text-text from btn for the pressed variant (or use the Button component), and assert the label is visible.
5. **MEDIUM: fullscreen is disabled in the player.** apps/api/naadi_api/security.py:116.
   - PERMISSIONS_POLICY `fullscreen=(self)` is also sent on /sandbox/youtube.html. Its 'self' is the opaque origin, so delegation to the nested embed is denied.
   - Measured: `document.fullscreenEnabled === false` inside the youtube-nocookie frame. Fix together with #1 (the sandbox page needs `fullscreen=(self "https://www.youtube-nocookie.com")` or equivalent). Fullscreen is part of the unmodified player on iPad.
6. **LOW: imported card text does not reference `sources`.** flashcards has no source_id. Only the WebP media rows reference 'user-upload' (importer.py:237).
   - CLAUDE.md: "every media or text asset references a sources row". Either add flashcards.source_id ('user-upload' for anki_import) or get a lead decision that origin='anki_import' + owner is the mapping, documented in the schema doc.
7. **LOW: the 0023 docstring claim is not enforced.** 0023 docstring line 19 says a student's own origin 'user' card "can carry none of" tags/anki_guid/anki_note_type, but flashcards_insert_own / update_own (0001:773-776) don't check it.
   - A student can set anki_guid on their own user card through supabase-js, which makes a later import of that note a silent no-op. Only the student is affected.
   - Fix: add `anki_guid is null and anki_note_type is null` to the with-check in a migration, with a db test.
8. **NIT:** apps/api/naadi_api/youtube/client.py:76. `execute(num_retries=2)` can spend up to 3 units while Quota.spend counted 1, so the ledger under-counts. That's harmless at a 2,000 budget against 10,000/day, but the ledger should be honest.

### Test results (local, own stack -review20, never the hosted DB or the Space)
- Unit `pytest -m "not live and not db"`: 1318 passed.
- Lint (biome + ruff + format): pass. Typecheck (tsc -r + mypy): pass. Vitest: web 513, shared 133, ink 75, all pass.
- db (`pytest -m db`, local supabase/postgres + storage + auth): all S20 tests (tests/anki, tests/youtube, RLS coverage, live_check, schema_doc) pass. Failures that are not S20:
  - tests/embeddings/* errors: the fastembed model can't be downloaded in this sandbox.
  - tests/db/test_migrations.py round-trip / downgrade / concurrent fail in **0024's downgrade** (`check (kind in ())`): its regex over pg_get_constraintdef produces an empty list. That's S21's migration; flagging it to the lead.
  - tests/authoring/test_store_db.py lint outcome and test_seed live_check figure: not S20 files.
- e2e smoke (video + anki + csp, including the prod-CSP routes with zero console errors) on webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390 and chromium-laptop-1440, `--retries=0 --workers=2`: **72/72 passed twice in a row** on a freshly migrated and seeded DB. These pass with the stubbed player, so they do not cover #1.
- CI run 44028033443 for 017555f: all 13 jobs still **queued**, so the full matrix can't be judged yet. Re-check before verify.
- Screenshots (iPad portrait/landscape, phone, laptop): video player, Anki import and report. Layout holds at 390, with nothing truncated or under the nav pill, apart from #4. One lime CTA per view (the import dialog's lime Import deck / Review these cards; the page's lime "New card" is behind the modal).
